title: React Counter (CDN React, no build step)
prompt:
Build a single static index.html that renders an interactive counter using React 18, loaded from a CDN (e.g. https://unpkg.com/react@18/umd/react.production.min.js and the matching react-dom build) via plain <script src> tags -- no npm, no build step, no bundler, no dev server. Do NOT use JSX or Babel (there is no transpile step to run it through); write the component with plain React.createElement(...) calls. The page must render, inside a mount point, exactly:
  - an element carrying data-testid="count" whose text content is the current count, starting at 0
  - a button carrying data-testid="increment" that increases the count by 1 (using React state, e.g. useState) each time it's clicked
  - a button carrying data-testid="reset" that resets the count back to 0 when clicked
Add a short README.md explaining how to open it. Also test it yourself in your Testing phase by actually opening it (or using execute_command with a headless check) and clicking the buttons to confirm the count updates -- don't just eyeball the source.

verify.description: Loads the real index.html in jsdom (executing its actual CDN <script> tags) and drives it with real dispatchEvent clicks, asserting the DOM actually updates -- behavioral, not just structural. See benchmark/README.md's Evaluation methodology section.
